verdict.rationale: Capacities documents block-based linking: typing `((` lets you reference an individual block from another page. It also lets you embed a block and its children inside another page, and the embedded block is identical to the original, so edits appear everywhere it is used. This directly covers referencing, transclusion and staying in sync. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of sync behavior, and explicit coverage of transcluding a whole headed section beyond block-plus-children.
